title: Marlowe & Finch Alterations Rush Fee Computation
content:
**Clause.** A Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket accepted with rush service owes one rush fee, booked once per ticket; a ticket not accepted with rush service owes none. The fee is worked out from three quantities:

1. **The rush-fee operation base** — the total of every operation charge and every lined surcharge charge booked on the ticket. The rush fee itself, extra fitting fees and payments are not part of it.
2. **The rush charge basis** — the class's rush fee percentage of the rush-fee operation base.
3. **The rush fee** — the rush charge basis multiplied by the lead-time multiplier percent and divided by one hundred, then multiplied by the adjustment figure (one hundred plus the lined-work premium, less the cardmember, new-purchase and occasion discounts) and divided by one hundred. The fee is rounded half up to the cent once, on that final figure, and never at an intermediate step.

On this computation the lead-time multiplier is 100 percent and the ticket carries no lined-work premium and no discount, so the adjustment figure is one hundred and the rush fee equals the rush charge basis, rounded half up to the cent.

**Rounding.** Half up to the cent: a figure at or above the half-cent mark goes up to the next cent, a figure lying within 0.0001 of a cent below that mark being taken as at the mark; a figure below it goes down.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A ticket in a class whose rush fee percentage is, for this example, 40 percent carries two operation charges of 30.00 USD and 40.00 USD and one lined surcharge charge of 8.00 USD.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Rush-fee operation base: 30.00 plus 40.00 plus 8.00 | 78.00 USD |
| Rush charge basis: 40 percent of 78.00 | 31.20 USD |
| Lead-time multiplier 100 percent, adjustment figure one hundred | 31.20 USD |
| Rush fee, rounded half up to the cent | 31.20 USD |

## Rounding example (hypothetical figures)

In a class whose rush fee percentage is, for this example, 25 percent, a rush-fee operation base of 50.10 USD gives a rush charge basis of 12.525 USD; the rush fee is 12.53 USD.
